description: This file defines classes and macros for warning reporting and warning categories, including configuration, serialization, and analysis functionalities. It includes class declarations for WarningReportingType, WarningReportingBoundsCategory, and WarningReportingUnitProxy, as well as macros for reporting warnings and bounds violations.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds-based warning categories, including configuration, serialization, deserialization, and analysis.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category with analysis, serialization, and warning status functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, exclusions, and event reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds and specific settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes whether a warning should be reported based on current value and category.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current value is considered a warning.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning reporting is enabled.
